notes: DISCOVERED during the m3-full-report-2026-12-03 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), and it earns a row on the inverse of the finding that motivated its proposer. The Atlanta Fed's release workbook splits its inputs into two columns: a trigger list that CAUSES a posted GDPNow update ("Construction spending", "ISM Manufacturing Index", "International trade (Full report)", "Wholesale trade", "Retail sales + inventories", "Housing starts", "Advance Census manufacturing (M3-1)", "Personal income and outlays") and an "Other releases" list folded in only when it happens to land on a trigger day. Construction Spending is a TRIGGER and is absent from this calendar entirely — no construction-spending entry exists in src/domain/market-events; the proposer, M3-2, is an "other release" and is tracked. Of the 13 M3-2 releases on the 2026 Census calendar, exactly 2 (01-29, 08-04) drew a posted GDPNow update, and both were days it rode an International-trade or Wholesale trigger; 9 more were internal updates with no public vintage. So the same corridor tracks the opportunistic half of a GDPNow morning and misses the causal half — the identical shape of hole the mtis-2026-12-16 lane described when IT was untracked. Two days ahead of the proposer and sharing a 10:00 slot with the tracked ism-manufacturing-2026-12-01. Impact LOW, symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-06).
